slides.myth: The CDL is valid, so an expired medical card doesn't matter
slides.fact: A lapsed medical card can sideline a driver even with a valid CDL.

slides.myth: No renewal notice came, so it's on the DMV
slides.fact: No notice rarely gets you off the hook. The registration date is still yours.

slides.myth: The policy renewed, so the old COI is close enough
slides.fact: Clients read the dates on the certificate. Send the updated one.

slides.title: Score 3/3?
slides.body: Save this and send it to whoever does the fleet paperwork.
